scenario: the first practical exchange about taxi & ride services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Taxi and Ride Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: taxi & ride services — the first practical exchange about taxi & ride services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about taxi & ride services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan hails a taxi driven by Mr Henry and asks for the hotel.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan gọi một chiếc taxi do anh Henry lái và xin đến khách sạn.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Henry, can you take me to the hotel, please?
turns.vietnamese: Henry này, anh chở tôi đến khách sạn được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Henry
turns.vietnamese: Được ạ, không sao đâu. Mời chị lên xe.
